response.sql: SELECT AVG(avg_length) AS avg_of_lengths, AVG(avg_ratio) AS avg_of_ratios FROM (SELECT rating, AVG(length) AS avg_length, AVG(rental_rate / replacement_cost) AS avg_ratio FROM film WHERE replacement_cost >= 20.99 GROUP BY rating) t;

assumptions.assumption: The replacement_cost threshold "set at 20.99" means >= 20.99 (films at or above the threshold), which is the standard interpretation of threshold in database queries.

alternatives.interpretation: The threshold could be interpreted as strictly above 20.99 (> rather than >=), meaning only films more expensive than 20.99.
